decision_rule.statement: Decided only by the cited QSL-20260930 rule, evaluated once: at 120 or more expiry-resolved cohorts per family, fully-crossed net mean above 0 with one-sided sign-flip p below 0.05 (10,000 draws), name-clustered bootstrap 95% CI low above 0, no single dropped name flipping the sign, both expiry halves agreeing in sign. minimum_sessions 67 is the measured projection of recorded sessions the binding family needs (QSL section 6), not a threshold of its own. The lane places no orders, so it has no lifecycles.

registration.hypothesis: The sealed QSL-20260930 quote-bearing shadow ledger continues unchanged under its own pre-registration, owner and timers. This entry only cites it so the pilot roster names all three programs; it re-registers nothing and grants the lane no new requests, compute or storage (every pilot budget below is zero, so no pilot job can run under this program id).

decision_rule.statement: This control has no signal; it measures what the desk mechanics, the exit policy and paper costs alone produce. Entry: the first NYSE session of each calendar week, a whole-share long SPY DAY limit order sized to at most 1,000.00 USD notional, proposed after 10:00 ET and sent only if the owner approves it. Exit: stop 2% below the entry limit (desk-watched), no target, deadline the third session after entry, forced exit 15:45 ET. Metric: mean net P&L in cents per completed lifecycle (C3.4 definition, commissions included) from the reconciled paper ledger. Read once, together with the challenger, when both have at least 20 completed lifecycles and at least 60 sessions have passed since the later seal.

registration.hypothesis: Control: a scheduled, signal-free SPY entry with the pilot's fixed exit policy sets the per-lifecycle outcome the challenger must beat. No edge is expected or claimed for the control itself.
registration.title: SPY weekly scheduled entry (equity control)

decision_rule.statement: Signal: SPY's recorded post-close price on session D is at least 1.00% below its recorded post-close price on the previous NYSE session (both recorded, cboe-delayed). Entry: on session D+1, the same order, sizing, owner approval and exit policy as the baseline (whole-share long SPY DAY limit at most 1,000.00 USD notional after 10:00 ET; stop 2% below entry; deadline the third session after entry; forced exit 15:45 ET); at most one open position. Decision, read once when both programs have at least 20 completed lifecycles and at least 60 sessions have passed since the later seal: the challenger beats the baseline only if its mean net P&L per completed lifecycle minus the baseline's is above 0 and the lower bound of a 95% bootstrap interval of that difference (10,000 draws, seed 20261021, lifecycles resampled within each program) is above 0. Otherwise it does not.

registration.hypothesis: Short-term reversal: after a recorded close at least 1% below the previous session's, a SPY entry under the pilot's fixed exit policy earns more net per completed lifecycle than the signal-free weekly control.
registration.title: SPY one-day reversal (preregistered equity challenger)
